task: FV2-022 — Flutter Design V2 protected image viewer overlay parity
summary: Fixed a mobile safe-area defect found during live viewer acceptance: Android system status/navigation insets now remain clear of the filename/download header and footer while the image overlay stays full-screen. Protected loading/save behavior is unchanged.

checks.name: Test-first system-inset regression
checks.command: cd clients/flutter && flutter test test/message_attachment_list_test.dart --plain-name 'keeps compact viewer controls clear of system insets'
checks.observation: Before the fix, the test failed with header.top=0 when the simulated system top inset was 24 px. After preserving MediaQuery.viewPadding, the header begins below the inset and the footer stays above the bottom inset.

checks.name: Protected image viewer focused tests
checks.observation: Loading/unavailable/retry/decode-error states, keyboard and semantics behavior, desktop/compact geometry, plus the new safe-area regression pass.

checks.name: macOS Debug runtime visual acceptance
checks.observation: Attached to the already-running macOS arm64 client and hot-reloaded 4 libraries without restarting the process or prompting for Keychain access. The viewer showed the full image, filename, separate download control and close action; Escape returned to Text. The live screenshot was not retained because it contains account and conversation content.

checks.name: Android API 35 runtime visual acceptance
checks.command: cd clients/flutter && flutter build apk --release --split-per-abi --build-name=1.0.29 --build-number=55; adb install -r build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-arm64-v8a-release.apk; inspect protected image viewer
checks.observation: Installed the signed arm64 split over versionCode 2054 without uninstalling or clearing app data. On emulator-5554 (Android 15/API 35), the protected image loaded and the viewer header/footer stayed clear of the status and gesture bars. Android Back closed the viewer and returned to the existing Text channel. APK is an ignored local test artifact, not a published release.
